proves.claim: Init in a copy of a scratch composer project records composer test as the gate.

cli.journeys-languages-php.init-records-.why: Without it, a regression where init stops detecting a composer project would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A submitted commit with a failing phpunit test is refused red and the refusal names the test.

cli.journeys-languages-php-red.a-failing.why: Without it, a regression where a red PHP gate is accepted or its refusal hides the failing test would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The fixed PHP commit passes composer test, is accepted and lands on the scratch board main.

cli.journeys-languages-php-land.the-fixe.why: Without it, a regression where a green PHP item cannot land would pass unnoticed.
